name: zinterp_context_tokenize_line
description: zInterp_Context::TokenizeLine strips comments, copies a text line into tempAlloc, skips leading whitespace, splits tokens on comma/space/tab/newline delimiters, and leaves prepared input untouched.
known_limits: No isolated VC COFF byte comparison is recorded; tier S verification is deferred to the coherent zInterp parser/runtime source-cluster pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation for 0x4c13c0 validates the prepared-input early return, tokenCount reset at offset 0x08, tokenReadIndex set to 1, comment scan at '#', copy into tempAlloc at offset 0x1c, delimiter string ', \\t\\n', tokenList entries at offset 0x20, NUL termination of separators, leading whitespace skips, newline break behavior, and non-empty tail token append.
The native smokes verify comma/space/tab/newline tokenization, comment stripping, newline tail retention, and the prepared-input early return preserving existing prepared-token state.
